About the Team

At Miro, design is intrinsic in everything we do. As a business we are on a mission to redefine how great work is done, and as a design team we aim to make that as easy and delightful as possible.

The design system team owns the leverage point that lets that craft scale: every component, token, and pattern either propagates quality across the product or quietly leaks debt into it. As a part of our Product Design team, you will contribute to our design process, culture, and experience principles and set new standards for design quality.

About the Role

Miro is a canvas — an infinite, multiplayer surface where millions of people think, run workshops, map systems, and build together. Design is what makes that canvas feel considered: fast, fluid, alive, and unmistakably Miro rather than a framework's defaults dressed up.

You own the design system — not by writing the infrastructure that enforces it, but by deciding what "great" looks like and turning that judgment into something the system can pull into the design process.

The design system is AI-native, meaning that agents will generate the first draft of the UI, using the tokens, components, and patterns you've defined. That changes the job. It used to be enough to design a good screen. Now the job is to design the soul and rules a screen gets generated from — to encode taste, not just constraints.

This is a design-first role with a strong foundation in code. You think and communicate in prototypes because they're more honest than a static mock. You reach for a quick build to test whether an idea actually feels right, not to ship production infrastructure. You're not the person building the rendering engine; you're the person with the eye to know when the rendering engine got it wrong.

What you'll do

 - You hold and push the quality bar forwards; meaning you don't only define what great design and taste looks like, you encode it.

 - Identify the interaction patterns, hierarchy rules, and softer signals (rhythm, restraint, spacing that "feels right") that keep AI-generated UI from feeling machine-made, then work with engineering to get those signals into the guardrails that catch violations before ship.

 - Push token thinking into motion, easing, spatial transitions, and multiplayer states like presence and cursors — the aesthetic decisions that make the canvas feel alive. 

 - Partner closely with engineering, making sure performance constraints don't flatten the product into something generic.

 - Build the patterns, guidelines, and examples that make every designer and AI-assisted contributor faster and more confident. Write things down — foundation-level thinking compounds.

What you'll need

 - 10+ years of product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or AI-focused roles.

 - At least 2-3 years operating at a Staff / Principal level, with proven ownership of complex initiatives.

 - Comfort in code sufficient to prototype and validate design ideas, without being primarily defined by engineering depth — this is a design-first role with a strong foundation in code.

 - The ability to see the difference between fine and right, and to say why out loud: taste here is judgment you can articulate, turn into a rule, and hand to someone else — the kind that notices the 1px that's off, the easing a beat too slow, the contrast that technically passes and visually fails.

 - An end-to-end understanding of the product — where a pattern breaks down in a real user flow, or where a component that looks fine in isolation causes friction in context.

 - A track record of influence beyond your own output: setting a quality bar explicit enough that others can apply it, and connecting fragmented, team-by-team work into something coherent.

 - Craft signals including visual craft and taste, pattern recognition at scale, motion and timing as a design decision, multiplayer interaction grammar (presence, cursors, conflict, co-authorship), and real fluency with AI tools and AI-driven product moments — enough to prototype your own ideas without needing an engineer to stand up a first draft.

 - Systems and governance thinking: the ability to articulate the contribution rules that keep a system coherent as it scales, even if someone else writes the enforcement code.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board. https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVG8Fi8Yc=/?moveToWidget=3458764661021134968&cot=10

dee27d5ed937e5d3.title: Senior Product Designer
dee27d5ed937e5d3.jd: RemoFirst  is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.  We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships.   As a  Senior   Product Designer , you will play a vital role in crafting effective, intuitive, and delightful interfaces by deeply understanding stakeholder needs, conducting user and business research, and translating insights into user experiences our customers will love to use. You will be responsible for creating wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, with a strong focus on onboarding flows and seamless AI feature interactions. You will test your UX solutions with customers, define optimal navigation and interaction patterns, and ensure design consistency with our brand guidelines, usability standards, accessibility best practices, and performance requirements.    What you will be doing    User and Business Research and Analysis:   Conduct research and analyze user and business needs to create effective interfaces with a focus on onboarding journeys.   Gather and interpret user feedback and data to inform design decisions.  Collaborate with stakeholders to understand project objectives and target audience.   Wireframing, Layout, and Design:   Create wireframes, layouts, and designs that meet user requirements and business goals, with strong creativity in UI to enhance onboarding flows and AI feature interactions.  Adapt designs for various devices and screen sizes.  Ensure design adherence to UX/UI principles and best practices, particularly for highly engaging and intuitive interactions.   Prototyping and User Testing:   Develop interactive prototypes to test and validate design concepts with users.  Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to refine designs.  Analyze user data and incorporate insights into design iterations.   Navigation and Interaction Design:   Define optimal navigation flows and interactions for websites and applications.  Ensure seamless user experiences by considering information architecture and user journeys.   Design Consistency and Technical Requirements:   Maintain design consistency and adhere to technical requirements during the development process.  Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure design feasibility and implementation.    Requirements    Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as a Product Designer, preferably with hands-on experience at tech startups, especially those with a heavy focus on UX.  A strong portfolio showcasing user-centered designs and successful projects.  Design Skills: Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools. Deep understanding of UX/UI design principles and the ability to create high-quality user interfaces.  Device Adaptation and Trends: Experience in adapting designs for various devices. Knowledge of UX/UI design trends and a strong desire to learn and grow in this field.  User Research and Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills, including conducting user research and analyzing data. Ability to gather insights and apply them to design solutions.     How you'll work    Proficiency in English  is a must.    Adept at cross-cultural communication:  Being a completely remote company, we’re working with people from different cultures across different time-zones. You will need to have a strong aptitude for proactive cross-cultural communication.   Systematic and Strong Time Management:  We have lots to achieve together as a team, and at times, you will need to be able to manage your time and priorities for yourself, and by yourself.   Knack for Design Thinking:  Our customers are at the heart of what we do. You will be expected to have a strong and empathetic approach to design thinking to deliver a stellar experience that our customers love to use.   Hyperlogical Problem-Solving : We’re moving and growing at a fast-pace, and that means being involved in solving complex problems. You will need to demonstrate a strong knack for first-principles, hyper-logical approach to solving problems and cutting through complexity.    Benefits     Startup environment:  RemoFirst is an early-stage startup. You have a voice that can influence, and grow rapidly. An opportunity to build a tech unicorn.    Growth opportunity:  This is a chance to join an AI-forward company driving innovation through artificial intelligence. As Product Designer, you’ll lead product initiatives that deliver strategic impact.   Direct impact:  Your work will be at the center of how we grow revenue, support customers, and differentiate in the market.   Autonomy and Accountability:  We value autonomy and accountability — there’s no bureaucracy or lengthy approval process. We prioritize speed and results to keep moving forward effectively.   Work for a Market Leader:  Scale a project that counts market-leading companies like Microsoft, Mastercard, and more as happy customers.    Leadership visibility:  Reporting into the Head of Product which means your projects will be strategic and business-critical.   Compensation and perks are great:  Competitive compensation. 100% remote work.    Culture:  You will get to work with some of the best colleagues coming from top tech companies. We lead with respect, kindness, and the right to fail. We value hard yet smart work. Diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA.  As we grow and evolve, we welcome your input to help us define our culture further.

e53fae0e2d514bcd.title: Director, Product Design
e53fae0e2d514bcd.jd: Director Product Design     Europe / Remote  Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer     About Velsera    Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine.   We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients.    The opportunity    You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with.   That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar.   This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create.   The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job.   This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk.      What will you do?    Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks.     Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build.     Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design.     Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it.     Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together.     Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma.     Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first.     Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level.       Your first few months    The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first.    Requirements    What do you bring to the table?   You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software.    You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive.     You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again.     You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself.     You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one.     You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead.     You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces.     You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.     You know enough front-end to collaborate credibly with engineers on components and constraints. You don't need to write production code, but you do need to understand how your designs become it.     You can operate as the most senior design voice in the company: comfortable with ambiguity, generous as a coach, and clear whether you're talking to executives, engineers or scientists.    Nice to have: experience with genomics, multi-omics, imaging, clinical or other life sciences data products, or another regulated domain; products delivered across multiple environments or installations; familiarity with component documentation tools like Storybook; experience establishing design practice in an engineering-led organization.       Why this position?   You get real authority over a core product and the design function itself, from day one, with a direct line to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer. You join a company that works the way it's asking you to work: AI-assisted, fast and hands-on. The work ends in research results and patient outcomes, which makes the pace worth it. And you won't inherit a design practice here; you'll build the one everyone after you inherits.    Benefits    Flexible Work & Time Off - Embrace hybrid work models and enjoy the freedom of unlimited paid time off to support work-life balance.  Health & Well-being - Access comprehensive group medical and life insurance coverage, along with a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health and wellness support.  Growth & Learning - Fuel your professional journey with continuous learning and development programs designed to help you upskill and grow.  Engaging & Fun Work Culture - Experience a vibrant workplace with team events, celebrations, and engaging activities that make every workday enjoyable.  & Many More...

da0d9478aa8ab2a8.title: Principal AI Model Designer
da0d9478aa8ab2a8.jd:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. 
 Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.   Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.  As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. 
 For everyone, everywhere.   More about   our mission   and   what we offer  .    Your mission   You’ll explore how to harness the potential of AI to scale your impact as a designer. You’ll quickly test and iterate on your ideas with a high degree of freedom and flexibility, learning as part of your day-to-day work as the technology evolves.  You’ll shape the core Wise Assistant experience for Support and beyond. You’ll design the system that guides our customers through every part of the Wise product, giving them quick and reliable help exactly when they need it. Together with your technical partners, you’ll architect and design agents, own prompts, and define how context and knowledge are used to resolve real customer problems.  This role will sit within the Content Design Guild as part of our Design team, as the disciplines share a common skill set and design process. 
    How you’ll contribute:    Together with a team of engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you’ll design the systems that enable Wise to deliver conversational AI experiences that help customers at the exact moment they need support.  You’ll collaborate with partners across engineering, data science, product, and design to set the vision and strategy, and coach teams to deliver it.  You’ll shape agent behaviour, define how components of the system interact, and own prompts, reasoning, and context.  You’ll be influential within your product area, identifying and prioritising system needs and delivering the most impactful projects across multiple teams.  Using your expertise, you’ll raise design maturity and deepen the Support squad’s understanding of context engineering.  As part of the Content Design Guild, you’ll regularly collaborate with Wise’s wider content community. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to partner with other Model and Content Designers to evolve how we approach working with AI as designers.       This role will give you the opportunity to:    Own the squad’s automation strategy end to end and steer its direction.  Champion quality for our customers—you’ll define what good looks like within the squad and demonstrate it through everything you ship.  Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken system and putting people and businesses in control of their money.       About you:    You’re an accomplished and experienced Model Designer, or a systems-focused Content Designer who has already made this transition in your day-to-day work. You bring extensive experience in designing large, complex automation systems that deliver exceptional experiences to customers.  You have an in-depth understanding of AI and strong perspectives on how its underpinning systems should be shaped, both within user-facing products and as part of the design process.  You’ve designed systems that generate content and experiences to guide customers, including prompts, guardrails, knowledge architecture, and agents.  You love learning new things, nerding out on technical details, and applying what you learn to solve complex problems.  You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating successfully in this kind of environment. You learn quickly and put what you learn into practice.  You have an eye for quality and know where to focus to improve it.  You’re influential and inspiring, and you work well with others in a culture that values autonomy and empowerment. You champion the role of model design and content design in automation-based projects and enjoy coaching designers who are new to these kinds of products.  You’re highly empathetic, both towards customers and the people you work with.       Heads up: this probably isn’t for you if:   You haven’t previously worked hands-on with a large-scale automated system. This role requires a high level of technical expertise and the ability to partner as an equal with data scientists and engineers when designing large, complex AI systems. You should already have a strong working knowledge of common prompt-engineering techniques and frameworks, context engineering, and agentic design.  Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism, or social media, and you have no hands-on experience in model design, content design, or UX.  You’re not comfortable navigating complexity or working in a fast-paced environment.   
       For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.  We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. 
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.  If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit  Wise.Jobs .  Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .

f722d4e31136103b.title: Product Designer (B2B)

TryHackMe takes people from cybersecurity beginner to job-ready through hands-on, gamified learning. More than 8 million people have learned with us - and thousands of companies now use TryHackMe to train their security teams.  That B2B product is where you come in. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the core B2B experience end to end: how organisations get started, how admins run their training programmes, and how it all hangs together. You'll design new features and improve what's already there, with a clear goal - deeper engagement and stronger adoption.  The role  You'll partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers across the teams building the core B2B experience: onboarding flows, the admin dashboard, and the business-specific features our growing customer base depends on. You'll also work with the B2C teams so the learning experience stays consistent, whether someone's on TryHackMe individually or as part of their company's team.  Day to day, you'll:     Own the Management Dashboard  - the tool admins use to oversee and direct their teams' training initiatives     Own the quality bar for B2B design , keeping it consistent and coherent across the whole product     Design new features  that solve real problems for our customers     Help shape B2B product strategy  alongside PM, engineering, data, and the founders     Work with GTM teams  (Marketing, Customer Success, Sales) to translate what they hear from customers into product decisions     Run user research and usability tests  to find the friction people hit     Make the case for your work  - communicate design vision and rationale clearly enough to move stakeholders, including the Founders and Head of Product     Put AI and emerging tools to work  to accelerate discovery, validation, and prototyping    Who does well here? d6d6cd92049399ab.title: UX & Product Design Lead
d6d6cd92049399ab.jd: About bunny.net   Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.  At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.  You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.  We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.  Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.    UX & Product Design Lead   The internet runs on infrastructure. But using that infrastructure shouldn't feel... well, like infrastructure.  That's where you come in.  As our UX & Product Design Lead, you'll help shape how developers experience bunny.net.  Working closely with product managers and engineers, you'll own the UX journey from early product ideas through to polished experiences developers love using.  This isn't a role where you'll approve every mockup. You'll be hands-on where it matters most, solving meaningful product challenges while building the systems, patterns, and culture that help great UX scale across bunny.net.  You'll spend your time experimenting with new ideas, using AI to move faster, and continuously refining the experiences we build.  The best UX often goes unnoticed, because everything just works.  If that excites you, you'll feel right at home.   What will you do?     Make powerful technology feel beautifully simple    Shape the experience of products used by developers around the world    Work side by side with product managers and engineers to solve tough problems    Build the systems and design patterns that help great UX scale    Prototype, experiment, and explore with AI and modern design tools    Lead and set standards for user research and define the personas that guide every design decision    Talk to customers often, and let their feedback shape what we build    Bring clarity to complex product decisions through design workshops and reviews    Raise the bar for usability, accessibility, and thoughtful product design    Help others become better designers by sharing knowledge, giving feedback, and leading by example     What will you bring?     7+ years of experience in UX, product design, or a similar role    Experience designing cloud infrastructure, and/or products for developers    Confidence designing for technical users, especially developers    Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative user research    A talent for turning technical complexity into intuitive experiences    Systems thinking: you know when to solve a problem once, and when to create a pattern that solves it for everyone    The ability to zoom out to strategy and dive into the details when it matters    A collaborative mindset and the ability to work closely with engineers to balance user needs with technical realities    Clear communication and the confidence to explain your thinking to anyone, from engineers to leadership    Curiosity about AI and modern tools, and a desire to keep improving how products are designed and built    An obsession with the little details that make powerful products feel fast, simple, and effortless     What will make us extra happy?     Experience building design systems, component libraries, or design tokens    Familiarity with frontend technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Angular    Experience designing for APIs, cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, or other developer tools    Experience using AI to accelerate research, prototyping, or product design    Experience mentoring designers or helping scale design practices in a product organization      Where should you be located?    Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.    What's in it for you?   Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.     100% flexible hours -  Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.     Remote-first by design  - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our  headquarters .     Medical, dental, and vision insurance -  Coverage worldwide.     Paid time off -  Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.     Meeting-free Thursdays  - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.     Home office budget -  We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.     Paid sick leave -  Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.     Parental leave -  Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.     Annual fluffle building  - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.     Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP)  - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.     Mental health support -  Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via   BetterHelp.com  .     Wellness budget -  An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.     Educational budget -  €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.     Music on us:  Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

fb0b08af63acaaeb.title: Senior Product Designer (Growth)
fb0b08af63acaaeb.jd: About InvestEngine  InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need. Unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and built for easy, long-term investing. We’ve built a strong foundation, have over £3 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team, now we’re ready to scale.  About the Role  We are hiring a  Senior Product Designer  to join our  Growth stream  and help deliver consistently high-quality product design work at pace.  This is a hands-on IC contract role. The core expectation is simple:  deliver build-ready design with low churn . Especially on our highest-priority, higher-risk customer journeys, that means getting work to a confident, build-ready state with minimal rework, through strong upfront clarity, solid collaboration and good judgement.  You'll work closely with Product and Engineering day to day, and partner with Design on standards, craft and our evolving Design System  What You’ll Do    Own design work end-to-end in the Growth stream, from early framing through to build-ready delivery and iteration after release    Produce clear, implementation-ready design output such as flows, states, edge cases, content and acceptance criteria, so engineering has less back-and-forth    Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to clarify problems early and avoid late-stage rework    Contribute to Design System usage and consistency through your delivery, reusing and improving patterns where needed    Use AI as part of your workflow to accelerate exploration and delivery, in a way that stays repeatable and legible to the team    Take part in our research and evidence practice. We run concept, usability and comprehension testing across the team, and you'll help plan and run studies, then turn findings and product and behavioural data into design decisions    Design in a regulated context, with a strong bias toward clarity, fair treatment and customer comprehension    What We’re Looking For     5+ years of experience designing digital products as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex product experiences.     Strong product design craft, spanning interaction design, systems thinking and end-to-end journey ownership    Comfortable being hands-on with research. You're happy to get stuck into user research as part of the role, with our support, and you make design decisions from evidence rather than opinion    Data-driven design. You use product and behavioural data, along with experiment results, to frame problems, prioritise and prove that designs actually work    High ownership and autonomy, comfortable operating as a senior contractor, clarifying ambiguity and driving work forward    Excellent collaboration, working as a partner to Product and Engineering rather than a service desk    Pragmatic judgement on quality versus speed, knowing where polish matters most    Comfort working within a design system and contributing to it    Comprehension-first, fair-treatment mindset. You design for genuine customer understanding, not just usability. Experience in a regulated environment such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, gambling or utilities is a strong advantage, but what matters most is that you can clearly evidence this mindset, whether or not it comes from regulated work    English fluency (C1 level and above) — we are a UK-based company, and the role involves regular communication with the team    Nice to Have    Experience with growth experimentation and funnel optimisation    Strong prototyping skills for quick validation    Prior experience operationalising AI in team workflows, beyond personal use    Fintech or investing-domain experience specifically. Regulated experience is a strong advantage, and the sector itself is a bonus    How We Work  We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and transparency. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root, not just treating the symptoms.   What We Offer   Impact from day one  You’ll take on meaningful work from the start, tackling real challenges that drive the stability, efficiency, and growth of our business.   Room to grow  As we scale, you’ll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities, influence how we work, and help shape our long-term direction.   Transparent and open culture  We share decisions openly, keep communication channels clear, and encourage collaboration across every part of the business.   Supportive, high-calibre team  Work alongside talented professionals who are experts in their fields — smart, driven, and generous with their knowledge.   Remote first and flexible  Work in the way that best suits you. We focus on results, not rigid hours, and trust you to manage your time effectively.  Our Hiring Process    Introductory call with our Talent team    Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve    Competency interview focused on your experience in operational risk and controls (may include a short task or case study)    Senior leadership interview to explore alignment with our culture, values, and strategic direction

4b2aaf970f8706e7.title: Product Designer
4b2aaf970f8706e7.jd: Product Designer    Middlesbrough or Lisbon - Hybrid       Do you want to help shape software that affects thousands of lives?    Who are we?  We are ranked as the UK’s #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.  If you are looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. Our teams are based in the UK, Europe, and India, working on products that are used on a global scale. We have a clear and defined road map to deliver over the next 3 years, which is centred around a large-scale digital transformation as well as continuing our growth and expansion.  We embrace diversity and equality and want our employees to be comfortable bringing their whole selves to work. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it improves every aspect of our business.      Purpose    To deliver high-quality, user-centric product design across Causeway’s suite of products, contributing to the CausewayOne Design Language and Design System while collaborating closely with product, engineering, and business teams to bring innovative solutions to life.  The Product Designer is a core member of the Product Design team, reporting directly to the Lead Designer. This role is responsible for end-to-end design of product features — from early-stage research and ideation through to detailed UI and handoff — ensuring all output meets the standards set by Concrete, the CausewayOne Design System.       Key Responsibilities        Product Design    •  Own end-to-end design of product features across web SaaS and mobile applications, from problem definition and research through to final UI design and developer handoff.   •  Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma, leveraging Concrete components, tokens, and patterns to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.   •  Conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesis to inform design decisions and advocate for user needs within product teams.   •  Contribute to design crits and async Figma reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback to maintain a high bar for design quality.   •  Collaborate with product managers and engineers to ensure design intent is accurately implemented, supporting QA at key delivery stages.   •  Create rapid prototypes to support sales, strategic storytelling, and stakeholder communication.     Design System & Tooling    •  Apply and help maintain the Concrete Design System, including components, tokens, and usage guidelines, flagging gaps or improvements to the Lead Designer.   •  Maintain well-organised, properly named Figma files that align with team conventions and the development repository structure.   •  Contribute to scalable templates and shared libraries, supporting consistency and efficiency across the design team.     Collaboration & Growth    •  Work closely with the Lead Designer, Product Director, Product Owners, and engineering teams to align design work with product strategy and delivery priorities.   •  Actively participate in 1-2-1s and performance reviews, taking ownership of personal development goals and growth within the P3 level framework.   •  Support cross-product alignment by working collaboratively across teams to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.   •  Explore and adopt AI tools and techniques where they can improve design quality, innovation, and productivity.       Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications        Skills & Experience    •  A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work across web and/or mobile products, with clear evidence of user-centred design practice.   •  Proficiency in Figma, including components, auto-layout, and prototyping; experience working within or contributing to a design system is a strong advantage.   •  Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, and accessibility best practices.   •  Experience working in an agile product environment, collaborating with product managers and developers throughout the delivery lifecycle.   •  Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale to stakeholders at varying levels.     Qualifications    •  A degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; typically 3–5 years of experience in product or UX design.   •  Experience in or appetite to learn about the Construction and/or Infrastructure sectors, and an interest in understanding how Causeway’s products serve that market.     What you get from us:   If you're looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. We believe everyone at Causeway has a vital role to play in our success. Causeway is fuelled by curiosity and is a place for people who beam with positivity and burn with ambition.  Our team is everything, so we’ll take good care of you. In fact, we give well-being the same priority as our other business goals. We’re strong advocates of work-life balance, offering hybrid working alongside the opportunity to work from modern, collaborative offices.     Our Values   We are      United . As part of a team, we’re better together.  We are    Agile . Be the change, we’re on a journey.  We are    Trusted . Do the right thing, we own this.  We are    Driven . Get stuck in, we make it happen.    Like all responsible companies Causeway is aware of the need to recognise the importance of protecting our environment and addressing the climate emergency. Causeway is a carbon neutral company and we offset our calculated carbon footprint. However, we recognise that offsetting is not a permanent solution, so we set environmental objectives to reduce our footprint year-on-year.

The Role  
 Help us build the operating system for human longevity. 
 Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one. 
 We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked. 
 This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it. 
 Tasks 
  What You'll Own  
  Product concept and experience design  
 
 Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists

Who we are   
 We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. 
   
 Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go! 
      The Mission  
 We are on a mission to democratize finance for over 7 million users. As our Senior Product Designer for Securities & Commodities, your mandate is to take the high-stakes, data-heavy complexity of equities, derivatives, commodities, and real-world assets (RWAs) and architect them into seamless, intuitive user journeys. In our collaborative, "no-silo" culture, this role tackles the heavy lifting of investment products at scale—partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Data and Compliance to drive real-time impact on conversion, retention, and user trust without sacrificing functionality. 
  What You Will Do  
 
 The core of this role involves designing end-to-end trading and investment interfaces for TradFi and RWA products across mobile and web platforms, with the clear goal of increasing customer engagement and monetization. 
 Dense financial mechanics—including margin trading, commodities trading, and automated recurring investments—must be translated into accessible, low-friction journeys that educate and empower both novice and experienced investors. 
 Comprehensive user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis will serve as your primary tools to diagnose funnel bottlenecks, validate product hypotheses, and continuously improve KPIs like trading conversion and drop-off rates. 
 Active contributions to our scalable design architecture are expected, applying the highest UX standards to ensure high-quality, consistent touchpoints across all investment areas. 
 Seamless partnership with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Legal teams in a fast-moving, regulated environment is critical to shape the product roadmap, validate customer problems, and ensure feasible, compliant feature implementations. 
 
  Who You Are  
 
 A strong background in Product/UX/UI Design is required, featuring mandatory experience designing for complex fintech, brokerage, trading, or wealth management ecosystems. 
 Exceptional proficiency in Figma, rapid prototyping, and interaction design is essential, alongside a proven ability to untangle data-heavy interfaces and intricate workflows into clean, elegant systems. 
 Behavioral analytics, A/B testing, and funnel metrics should naturally drive your design decisions to proactively identify opportunities that boost customer engagement, adoption, and retention. 
 A proven track record of thriving in fast-moving, highly regulated environments will demonstrate your ability to successfully negotiate solutions that satisfy strict Risk and Compliance requirements without compromising the end-user experience. 
 High customer empathy and excellent stakeholder management skills are necessary to build long-term user trust while championing a product-driven, highly collaborative culture across the organization. 
    What’s in it for you  
 
  Flexibility to work where you thrive  – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice. 
  Reward for your impact  – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan. 
  Support for your mental wellbeing  – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP. 
  Time to recharge  – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months. 
  Continuous learning and growth  – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace. 
  Exclusive perks and rewards  – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel. 
  Support during life milestones  – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family. 
  Fuel and focus on-site  – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long. 
  Recognition for your contributions  – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda. 
  Show your Bitpanda pride  – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent. 
  Connect and celebrate with your team  – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration 
 
        .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are. 
   
 Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform. 
  Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

#LI-HYBRID     #LI-YY1   
 At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create. 
     
 We are looking for a product designer to work on  Air , the company's new agentic development environment. Air is a new kind of developer tool: a workspace where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. The product includes a native desktop app and a web-based experience, with cloud execution and collaborative workflows in the works. AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, and our goal is to design an environment that makes this shift feel natural, for both solo developers and entire engineering teams.  We’re looking for someone who can lead design initiatives, own key product areas, and bring clarity and usability to complex technical workflows. Design plays a critical role in these products by helping developers stay in flow, reduce their cognitive load, and work more confidently across tools.   
  In this role, you will:  
 
 Design and deliver high-quality user interfaces by creating wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes. 
 Lead large-scale initiatives from vision and strategy to execution. 
 Collaborate with product managers, developers, and researchers to define problems, align on goals, and ensure design solutions meet user and business needs. 
 Communicate design concepts and decisions to the team to promote alignment and comprehension. 
 Collaborate with the UX Research and Analytics team to validate ideas and create design solutions grounded in real user needs and behavioral data. 
 Work closely with the development team to implement and review your UI/UX solutions. 
 Improve design processes together with the UX team, helping with the development of our design system to maintain visual and functional consistency across the product while enabling flexibility and scale. 
 
     
  We will be happy to have you on our team if you have:  
 
 At least 5 years of experience in UI/UX design. 
 Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where the product, technology, and priorities evolve quickly. 
 Experience designing complex functional interfaces.  
 A willingness to dive into complex topics related to programming. 
 The ability to prototype, verify, present, and provide reasoning for your UI/UX solutions. 
 Diligence and attention to detail. 
 Spoken and written English at a level sufficient for everyday communication and writing documentation. 
 Proactivity, independence, and strong time-management skills. 
 The ability to work in a team and seek feedback to improve your solutions and processes. 
 
     
  We would be especially thrilled if you have experience:  
 
 Designing for developer-focused products or technical environments. 
 Designing complex functional interfaces. 
 Programming and working with AI. 
    We are an equal opportunity employer   We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

ecc5211b9b533e82.title: Principal Product Designer
ecc5211b9b533e82.jd:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!    Your opportunity   
 As a Principal Product Designer on the UX Platform team, you will be the most senior individual design voice across the breadth of the UX Platform: the products our engineers and customers rely on every day, and the Design System that ties them together. You will partner closely with our Design Director as a trusted right hand, owning the hardest and most ambiguous problems, setting the quality bar, and helping decisions move so design is never the bottleneck. 
 Two things sit at the center of this role: designing for AI-native experiences, and rethinking how design itself gets done in AI-first workflows. We are fully immersed in both, and this role has a real hand in shaping where they go. We want someone genuinely eager to learn, test, and experiment here, but with the judgment to tell where AI raises the quality of the work and where it just adds noise. The aim is to use AI where it genuinely makes the work better, not to adopt it for its own sake. 
 You are a pragmatic optimist: ambitious about where we could go, honest about the terrain in front of us. You can hold “this is hard and might not work” and “let’s do it anyway, here’s how” in the same breath. You lead through craft and influence rather than authority, you take a vague problem and give it shape, you bring strong opinions but invite better ones, and you raise risks early and honestly. You lift the people around you by example, and the whole team’s work gets sharper because you are on it. 
   
  What you'll do   
 
 Own the most complex and ambiguous design problems across our platform scope, from framing through detailed craft, end to end and with no oversight required. 
 Design for AI-native experiences: shape interfaces that are non-deterministic and adapt to each use, design for outputs we cannot fully predict, and set the design principles and heuristics that keep those experiences coherent. 
 Evolve how we design in AI-first, spec-driven workflows: help define how our role shifts, act as a multiplier for the team, and build ways to evaluate that we are shipping higher quality software, not just more of it. 
 Set the bar for documentation and traceability: clear specs, references, and rationale that the team, our partners, and our AI tools can build on. 
 Act as a second senior point of design judgment and a subject matter expert on our product: deputize for the Design Director in Product and Engineering reviews, shape strategic direction, and hold the quality bar across the whole product, not only your own area. 
 Strengthen the connection between product design and the Design System, and define systems and processes that others across the company can benefit from. 
 Partner with Product and Engineering to align on direction and keep work moving at a healthy cadence. 
 Mentor designers, lead by example, and raise the overall level of craft across the team. 
 
  This role requires     
 
 Extensive product design experience, including senior or lead work on complex software products. 
 A portfolio that shows depth of craft and systems thinking across both product design and design systems, and recognized mastery of craft: a track record of raising the collective quality bar and defining patterns, systems, or processes that others adopt. 
 A track record of owning ambiguous problems independently and driving them to real outcomes, end to end and without oversight. 
 Comfort designing for AI-native, non-deterministic experiences, and enthusiasm for evolving how design gets done in AI-first workflows. 
 A discerning approach to AI: eager to experiment, but with the judgment to tell where it adds real value, and a quality bar that does not bend for the sake of hype. 
 Ability to act as a subject matter expert who shapes priorities, leads research where useful, and interprets analysis into design decisions. 
 Proven ability to influence Product and Engineering partners without formal authority. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and a habit of documenting decisions, rationale, and references clearly so that people and tools can build on them. 
 
  Bonus points if you have  
 
 Experience designing services and platforms, especially in observability, developer tools, data, or complex B2B products. 
 A technical background: an understanding of modern software architecture, and experience with data visualization. 
 Experience contributing to or stewarding a design system at scale. 
 Hands-on experience with spec-driven or AI-assisted design workflows. 
 Comfort working in a distributed, cross-cultural team. 
 
 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.   Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.  
 If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to  resume@newrelic.com . 
 We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid. 
  Our hiring process   In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.  We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the  San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .  Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic. 
 New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process. 
 Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.  
 Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at  https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

About SecurityScorecard:   
  SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.   
   Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the      World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023    and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.”  SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.   
   About the Role:   
  We're hiring a Senior UX Architect to own information architecture and structural UX across our entire product surface — new platform builds and legacy areas alike. This is a senior, horizontal role that sits just below the leadership tier and carries genuine influence over how our product is structured and how our design org thinks.  
  Today, much of our structural UX expertise lives in one place at the leadership level. This role exists to scale that expertise across every product swimlane — shifting the team from aesthetic-first to architecture-first design thinking, where great aesthetics are the  result  of sound structure, not a substitute for it. You'll also be the structural foundation our AI product work builds on, ensuring intelligent product experiences sit on top of a clean, scalable UX layer rather than inheriting structural debt.  
  This is the kind of work that quietly determines whether a product feels effortless or exhausting — and whether customers stay. If you want to be the person who sets and holds that bar across an entire platform, this is your seat.  
   What You'll Do:   
 
   Own information architecture across all surfaces.  Maintain a coherent IA across new and legacy platform areas. Audit existing structures, find the fracture points, and resolve them with a long-term foundation in mind.  
   Set and carry cross-swimlane UX standards.  Operate horizontally across every product design swimlane, ensuring structural UX thinking is applied consistently — everywhere the product lives, not just where attention happens to land.  
   Be the quality checkpoint for prototypes.  Review prototypes across product areas as a structural-integrity gate, so work moves forward faster and with confidence — and nothing ships with structural debt baked in.  
   Champion a blueprint-first design motion.  As the org adopts a blueprint-first approach (defining the  what  and  how  in low fidelity before any high-fidelity layer), you'll be the keeper of the bar — ensuring every output meets our UX, IA, and best-practice standards.  
   Elevate the design practice.  Coach and model what strong structural thinking looks like, leveling up the team so it builds things right from the start rather than requiring correction after the fact.  
   Build the UX foundation for AI products.  Partner closely with the AI product team to ensure the UX layer is structured, scalable, and ready to support intelligent product experiences.  
   Hold platform integrity — old and new.  Maintain the standard across the current platform and future builds, progressively bringing legacy areas up to standard.  
   Transfer knowledge and level the team.  Spread UX architecture thinking throughout the design org, building a team that constructs correctly from the start.  
 
   What You'll Bring:   
 
  8+ years of hands-on and/or managerial  UX experience  with deep, demonstrated expertise in  information architecture  and  structural/systems-level SaaS design .  
  A track record of owning IA across complex, multi-surface products — including untangling fractured or legacy structures.  
  The ability to set standards and influence horizontally across multiple teams without direct authority — leadership through craft and clarity.  
  Experience establishing design processes, review practices, and reusable patterns/component foundations at scale.  
  Fluency partnering with Product and Engineering on AI or platform-level initiatives, with an eye for building UX foundations that scale.  
  The judgment to know when aesthetics are doing real structural work and when they're papering over a weak foundation.  
   Leader mentality:  An excellent communicator, patient observer, and a keen feedback-giver.  
  Engineering experience (JSON, CSS, C++) / Python-ML background — a plus.  
 
  UX Architecture & IA Health  
 
  A measurable reduction in IA-related rework and structural revisions after handoff.  
  Every prototype reviewed against blueprint-first standards before progressing.  
  A clear decline in siloed design decisions across product swimlanes.  
 
  Design Velocity  
 
  Prototype review cycles compressed from weeks to days.  
  Fewer design-to-dev miscommunication loops and back-and-forth cycles.  
  Blueprint completion consistently running ahead of visual design sprints.  
 
  Customer Impact  
 
  Quarter-over-quarter NPS improvement.  
  Increased platform and customer retention.  
  Fewer support tickets and friction points tied to navigation, IA, and workflow confusion.  
 
  AI & Platform Readiness  
 
  Core platform surfaces assessed and documented as AI-ready.  
  Zero new AI features shipped on top of unresolved IA debt.  
  A clean, consistent component and pattern library established as the foundation for AI product builds.  
 
  Team Elevation  
 
  Measurable uplift in the team's blueprint-first output quality over 6–12 months.  
  A steady reduction in leadership-level intervention required on structural UX decisions.  
  UX standards adopted and self-applied across swimlanes — without top-down correction.  
 
  Who You Are:  
  Our Experience Design & Research team has a unique fabric, and we hire for it  deliberately  — at this level, how you carry it matters as much as your expertise:  
 
   You push yourself to do your best work.  You set a high structural bar and you're energized by getting the foundation right.  
   You have a growth mindset.  You seek out feedback and incorporate it, and you create the conditions for others to do the same.  
   You care about the people around you.  You're committed to elevating the whole team. This is not a "rockstar" seat — it's a force-multiplier seat. You make everyone better.  
   You lead with humility.  You're deeply experienced and entirely secure — which is exactly why you can coach, listen, and influence rather than dictate.  
 
   Benefits:   Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

Team   The Design team at Raisin, consisting of product designers and brand & marketing designers, is united by a shared belief in the power of esteem, creativity, and purpose. We foster a collaborative environment where empathy and innovation thrive, guided by integrity and high standards. Embracing diversity, we harness the strength of varied perspectives to adapt and achieve our vision. Our commitment to creativity and doing the right thing drives us to embed empathy and curiosity in all we do.   Your Responsibilities  
 
 Lead design discovery and delivery for end-to-end initiatives across multiple facets of the Raisin investment and pension product offering, proactively identifying opportunities where AI can simplify complex financial journeys. 
 Collaborate closely with your cross-functional agile peers of product owners, engineers, and data specialists to design and deliver high quality experiences, and iterate upon them as you gather insights on their effectiveness. 
 Collaborate closely with your cross-functional agile peers of product owners, engineers, and data specialists to define the UX infrastructure for AI-driven features, ensuring we co-create best-in-class, personalized, and highly secure digital products. 
 Use your depth of knowledge of customer expectations, behaviors (with support of emerging AI capabilities) to define strategic goals and critical hypotheses of what makes a highly desirable, usable, and trustworthy product.

fd2549c04124a669.title: Senior Design Engineer, Design System
fd2549c04124a669.jd:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.    Why this role matters  
 At Celonis, design has to scale across a complex, enterprise-grade process intelligence platform, and increasingly, it has to scale to machines as well as people. AI coding agents now generate a growing share of the UI our engineers ship, and our design system is the contract that keeps that output on-brand, accessible, and consistent. 
 This role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and product, with a strong emphasis on craft, usability, and scalability. You'll design and build the system itself, owning interaction decisions and front-end architecture, and translating complex process data and AI-driven behaviors into intuitive, high-performance experiences. It's a senior role: you'll often operate with minimal design oversight, set standards, lead initiatives, and mentor others while staying deeply hands-on in both design and code. 
  About the team  
 You'll join the team that owns Celonis's design system and the operations behind how design gets done. We sit at the intersection of design and engineering, and we treat the system as a living product with real users, internal designers, product engineers, and the AI agents that now consume it. 
  What you'll do  
 
 Design and build production components in Angular and TypeScript, our design system is built in Angular and we may adopt React over time, on a foundation of rock-solid HTML and CSS (semantic markup, ARIA, and modern CSS custom properties driving design tokens). 
 Own interaction decisions, component design, and front-end architecture end-to-end, independently translating ambiguous requirements into thoughtful, usable UX. 
 Translate complex process-intelligence data and AI-driven behaviors into clear, intuitive, high-performance operator experiences. 
 Set the technical and craft standard for front-end quality, polish, motion and animation, performance, and accessibility, across the team. 
 Drive rapid prototyping to explore novel interaction concepts and turn ambitious design visions into distinctive, testable experiences. 
 Collaborate with designers, PMs, and engineers to derive and evolve the design system through a healthy contribution model. 
 Make the system agent-ready: maintain tokens-as-code in the W3C DTCG format (Style Dictionary or similar) and structure component metadata, docs, and APIs so AI coding agents can consume them as reliable context. 
 Author and maintain Figma Code Connect mappings so Figma components link cleanly to their coded counterparts for engineers and agents alike. 
 Build evals as guardrails, visual-regression, accessibility, and token-compliance checks in CI, so generated and contributed UI meets the bar before it ships. 
 Use AI tooling daily (Figma Make, v0, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar), applying senior design and engineering judgment to critique and correct the output. 
 Lead system initiatives and mentor designers and engineers contributing to it. 
 
  What you'll bring  
 
 Around 5–8 years across design engineering / UX engineering / front-end, including significant hands-on work building a design system or component library in a SaaS or B2B environment. 
 Excellent UX instincts with strong attention to interaction detail and usability, you can own design decisions independently, with minimal oversight. 
 Strong production front-end skills in Angular and TypeScript with rock-solid HTML and CSS fundamentals; experience with (or genuine openness to) React is a plus. 
 Deep understanding of design token architecture (primitive → semantic → component tiers) and modern token pipelines. 
 Strong Figma fluency and comfort moving fluidly between design and code. 
 Demonstrated accessibility expertise (WCAG 2.2) implemented in code. 
 Hands-on fluency with AI design and coding tools, and an opinionated, responsible point of view on using them. 
 A strong product mindset and bias toward ownership, plus the communication and leadership of a senior IC. 
 
  Bonus points  
 
 Experience with Figma Code Connect in production. 
 Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers e.g. the Figma Dev Mode MCP server or a custom design-system MCP server. 
 Experience building evals for AI-generated UI, or writing specs/prompts for AI generation. 
 Background working on complex, data-dense, or real-time interfaces (a strong fit for our process-intelligence product). 
 Token-pipeline experience with Style Dictionary, Tokens Studio, or equivalent. 
 
  How we work  
 This is a senior role: you'll own major areas of the system with full autonomy, design and ship with a high bar for craft, set the standards others build to, lead initiatives, and mentor. We pair design craft with engineering depth and high curiosity about AI, building a system that's faster and safer for humans and agents alike.    What Celonis can offer you:  
 
  Pioneer Innovation:  Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. 
  Ownership from Day 1:  Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. 
  Unrivaled Family Support:  Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. 
  Work-Life Integration:  Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. 
  Continuous Growth:  Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. 
  Holistic Well-being:  Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. 
  Drive Sustainability:  Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. 
  Global Inclusion & Belonging:  Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. 
  Value-Driven Impact:  Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. 
 
  About Us:  
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. 
 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this  video . 
  Celonis Inclusion Statement:  
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.    
  Your Privacy:  
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’  Accessibility and Candidate Notices  
 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our  Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . 
 Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more  here .
